The plate looks like a square plate of about 24-26 cm, and it holds a fairly full serving of several items. I estimated each item's weight and energy from its apparent size on the plate:

| Item | Mass (g) | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---|---|
| Scrambled eggs | 100 | 150 |
| Fried rice | 100 | 170 |
| Roasted potatoes | 80 | 100 |
| Broccoli | 70 | 50 |
| Strawberries and blueberries | 50 | 20 |
| Pineapple | 60 | 30 |

Adding these gives about 460 g and about 520 kcal. That seems a bit high for the amount visible, so I lowered the estimate slightly.
